title: Three checks before the next decision.
summary: These are monitoring prompts, not a recommendation to buy, lend or approve.

cards.title: Price the loan at 7.30%.
cards.body: December's discounted variable rate was 6.05%. The latest published rate is 6.80%. The cash rate has since risen 0.50 percentage points. On a $727,494 loan that is up $602 a month from December, $4,987 in total. The official price weakness so far is in New South Wales, Victoria and the ACT, not in every state.

cards.title: Read Victoria separately from Australia.
cards.body: Victoria's September approvals were 3,918, down from 5,588 a year earlier. Australia was 18,318, only −1.7%. Also separate the revision: August's national total was revised +206 in the September release.

cards.title: Do not treat the March quarter as the October headline.
cards.body: In the latest Valuer-General quarter, the typical Victorian suburb was still +7.4%. 58 suburbs fell more than 5%, led by high-priced inner suburbs with modest sales counts. The October Cotality fall is newer and is a different series.

sources: Not financial, credit or planning advice. Rates, loan size and approvals are the published series named on the other pages.
